At closing, handler pairs stood out in your note, and we are sorry that your experience with Aurelia Skyways and the Companion Animal Travel Desk left you feeling that your companion animal was not treated with the care and attention that should be standard throughout the journey. You explained that the cabin conditions, the handling process, and the communication around the incident did not meet your expectations, and that concern is taken seriously by our safety review team.

We regret that the welcome and boarding support did not provide the reassurance you should have received. Our process is intended to coordinate care from booking through pickup, with a safety coordinator reviewing foreseeable hazards and the welcome team helping passengers prepare before boarding. When any part of that chain falls short, especially where an animal's comfort or welfare is involved, we are obligated to examine it carefully and improve the response.

Your report will be reviewed with attention to the handling environment, the communication trail, and the conduct of the staff who were present. We also review whether the onboard conditions remained within the standards expected for companion animal transport, because prompt, respectful communication is part of the service commitment that Aurelia Skyways makes to travelers who entrust us with an animal. Where a claim concerns injury or cabin overheating, the applicable recovery guidance and filing process are handled through the established case review path, and the related notice has been placed with your file for reference. <<FACT F113>> The same review file also includes the notice that applies when cabin overheating is alleged. <<FACT F117>>

Please accept our sincere apology for the distress this caused. We understand that trust is central when a traveler places a companion animal in our care, and we are taking your complaint as a safety matter rather than a routine service issue. You can expect a direct follow-up once the review is complete, and we will not minimize the concern you raised. Thank you for bringing this to our attention and for giving us the opportunity to address it with the seriousness it deserves.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
